answer: Because the cipher decay is applied at each close, the juniper audit publishes the reduced weight and the seat has to be earned again. A juror that skips cases loses 34% of its weight per missed epoch, so sitting on a seat without doing the work is not a passive strategy. A farm that parks keys in the jury pool hence watches its influence decay while paying the ledge fee to keep them eligible. A 499 account operation therefore ties up 36 million dollars of idle capital. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
